A chain wears out much faster when it is left dry because the oils and lubricants in the chain are designed to keep the metal parts moving smoothly and reduce friction. When the chain dries out, these protective oils evaporate or become brittle, leading to increased friction between the links. This extra friction causes wear on the chain, the gears, and the bicycle components much quicker than if it were properly lubricated.
